scope: Internal authenticated remote index-starting reads and same-cut hydration before and after correction on two partitions with three native OS processes each.

semantic_checks: Queries start from unique-property or incidence selectors, without caller-supplied candidate IDs.
Both partitions service genuine authenticated Get/Scan requests; returned candidates are hydrated through the same certified read operation.
Held old and newly reopened At(old) answers retain exact typed values, references, component bytes, revisions and provenance after correction; current answers reject stale effective matches.
Remote unchanged owner and phantom selector checked; both endpoint directions and canonical/declared incidence retain immutable life-bound edge identity.
Actual per-voter Resolve outcomes, CDC and roots agree. This is replica parity, not a new independent full CDC semantic oracle.
Six child processes are reaped, with zero owned views/pins/sessions.

negative_control.actual_failure: pre-correction exact raw index candidates p12 [] [17]
negative_control.qualification: Meaningful raw-index omission detected; no current-state-substitution or reproduced production-bug claim.

independent_review.scanners: Formatting, vet, build, pinned lint (zero issues) and pinned security pass. Production and dependencies match the accepted base; vulnerability scanning is not claimed anew.
independent_review.coverage: Fresh selected graphapply/graphstore/graphstate profile exercises index and hydration receiver methods. No new production method or changed production threshold; unchanged base retains its separately accepted broader coverage.
independent_review.resources: Each local Go invocation is bounded by 4GiB aggregate process-tree RSS and 180s, Go1.26.9, GOMAXPROCS2, GOMEMLIMIT2GiB, GOFLAGS-p1, GOWORKoff; Docker tools use 4GiB/2CPU.

fixture_qualifications.initial_failures: Compiler-only failures and original cumulative calls1024/1024 admission refusal are retained and are not semantic REDs. Initial evolving source snapshots were not retrospectively sealed.
fixture_qualifications.operation_lifetimes: Seven admitted certified operations; held primary owner is reused before/after, and separate exact-cut At operations service remaining selectors. No live ledger reset; two-session cap unchanged.
fixture_qualifications.traffic_qualification: E18-only fixture allowance, not an algorithmic worst-case or production SLO; default fixture allowance and production source/session/frame/queue limits are unchanged.

limitations: One physical host with six native OS processes; no multi-host durability claim.
Existing node-unique schema and relationship endpoint/incidence mirrors; no relationship-unique schema expansion.
Broader selector/scan parity and V4 public API acceptance remain separate.
Broader ownership recovery, production identity reuse/fencing, application GC, physical-host durability and comparable transactional-KV engine decision remain V2 requirements.
No full V2 or V3-V7 acceptance, performance or release claim.
